name: Hex
summary: Data workspace combining notebooks, conversational analytics, dashboards and data apps.
description: Hex is a collaborative data platform where analysts work in SQL and Python notebooks, business users ask questions in natural language, and teams publish dashboards and interactive data apps. It manages semantic context for AI answers. A Community plan is free; Professional costs $36 per editor per month and Team $75 per editor per month with a 14-day trial; compute beyond small sizes is billed per hour.

howToUse.title: Open a workspace
howToUse.description: Open Hex and start for free, or request a demo.

howToUse.title: Work in a notebook
howToUse.description: Create a notebook and run the analysis in SQL or Python with the other analysts.

howToUse.title: Let a teammate ask in plain language
howToUse.description: A colleague can ask a question without writing a query. Hex uses the team's semantic context for the answer.

howToUse.title: Publish a dashboard or a data app
howToUse.description: Share the result as a dashboard or an interactive data app. Community is free. Professional and Team are the paid editor plans.
